facts.fact: Rukmini lent a mackerel skiff for a day for four panam, no questions asked; Pavi sculls it under the cliff.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Pavi keeping a boat at the cliff foot.

facts.fact: A stone-framed spray slot in the sea stair roof, a body wide, opens above Usha's landing; Neela enters by rope through it and leaves by the stair, past the landing and out through a fish wicket where porters bring in the palace catch.
facts.why: needed to reconcile the rope climb with the stair descent and the landing guard change.

facts.fact: Neela pricks her left thumb with three lime thorns half an hour before the gun, so Devan gets an early signal; his own late signal arrives an hour after noon as three welts.
facts.why: needed because the outline has her unable to signal at noon and receiving his late one.

facts.fact: The thirty crown-leaf pages are stiff pale leaves in black resin-ink, each with its intake roll looped on by green thread, resting on blue cloth in the chest; a folded-wing bird in thin brown line sits in each margin. The farm lock hangs open on the hasp.
facts.why: needed to render the chest contents and the clue echoing Ittan's 'by leave' lines and the ledger stubs.

facts.fact: The queen's petition answers are signed 'Nirmala' in full in a quick slanting hand, with no stamp or clerk copy; she pays one widow from her own purse. Neela hears the queen's warm voice say 'leave the shutters, I like to hear it'.
facts.why: needed to show the queen's room and her as a non-strawman antagonist.

facts.fact: Cheru's widow of Kalladi is the topmost petitioner.
facts.why: needed as a concrete petition detail.

facts.fact: Of the thirty night-guards, twenty-two (Usha, Sanu and Sajan among them) agree to come at dawn; eight refuse, including Lata, who will take her page only from the queen's hand.
facts.why: needed to land the 22/8 split from the beat.

facts.fact: The hook welt at noon tears across Neela's right ribs under the arm, matching Devan's boarding-hook wound in ch 14.
facts.why: needed to tie the wound-share to ch 14.
